------Script set up------

```{r : reading libraries, include= FALSE}
packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "dplyr", "magrittr", "mixtools", "emmeans", "readr","data.table", "lubridate", "ggplot2", "magrittr", "skimr", "ggstatsplot","summarytools", "knitr", "here", "ggthemes", "ggthemes", "Amelia", "tidyr", "naniar", "stringr", "janitor", "readxl")

lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r : reading in data}
participantsnoduplicates <- read.csv("Data/3 Cleaned data/CaHASE2 Feb 25 extract/participantsnoduplicatesFeb25.csv", header=T, na.strings="")
# participantsnoduplicates$Date.of.Assessment <- as.Date(participantsnoduplicates$Date.of.Assessment, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
# ^ contains data entered into registry between 08/01/2019 and 07/02/2025

# ## test
core_data <- read.csv("Data/3 Cleaned data/CaHASE2 Feb 25 extract/participantsnoduplicatesFeb25.csv", header = T, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
# # THIS IS THIS A RECORD OF EVERYONE IN THE REGISTRY - ONE LINE PER PERSON
# ##

medication_clean <- read.csv("Data/3 Cleaned data/CaHASE2 Feb 25 extract/medication_cleanFeb25.csv", header=T, na.strings= c("", "NA"))
medication_clean <- remove_empty(medication_clean, c("cols"), cutoff = 1)

meds_wide <- read.csv("Data/3 Cleaned data/CaHASE2 Feb 25 extract/meds_wideFeb25.csv", header = T, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

CAH_biomarkers <- read.csv("Data/3 Cleaned data/CaHASE2 Feb 25 extract/CAH_biomarkers.csv", header = T, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

# N.B: using CAH biomarkers instead of labs_wide due to separation of numbers and unit chrs being present in CAH biomarkers and NOT in labs_wide.
```

*********************************
Make 'core_relevant' based on the CO.IDs present in the participants frame covering the time frame you're interested in.

```{r : removing participant info for those out of time frame}
CO.IDs <- unique(participantsnoduplicates$CO.ID)

core_relevant <- subset(core_data, CO.ID %in% CO.IDs)
core_relevant$Date.of.Birth <- as.Date(core_relevant$Date.of.Birth, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
```

*********************************
------Basic stats------
- USE CORE_RELEVANT FOR STATS HERE SO THAT EACH PATIENT COUNTS AS A SINGLE DATA POINT (not however many number of entries they have).
- sex distribution
- age distribution

```{r : sex}
sex_stats <- core_relevant %>%
  group_by(Sex.at.birth) %>%
  summarise(n = n())
```

```{r : age}
age_stats <- core_relevant %>%
  summarise("median age" = median(Age),
            "minimum age" = min(Age),
            "maximun age" = max(Age))
```


*********************************
------Visit stats------
- patients per centre
- visits per centre
- number of medication entries
- number of lab entries (?)

```{r : patients and visits per centre}
centre_stats <-participantsnoduplicates %>%
  group_by(Centre.ID) %>%
  summarise("number of patients assessed" = n_unique(CO.ID),
            "number of registry entries" = n())

# note that the 'number of patients' is the number of patients who have been assessed and had =>1 entry into the registry, NOT THE TOTAL NUMBER OF PATIENTS RECRUITED.
```

```{r : visit stats}
visitsperparticipant <- participantsnoduplicates %>%
  group_by(CO.ID) %>%
  summarise(n = n())

overallvisitsstats <- visitsperparticipant %>%
  summarise("total number of patients" = n(),
            "total number of visits" = sum(n),
            meanvisits = mean(n, na.rm = TRUE),
            medianvisits = median(n, na.rm = TRUE),                                            
            sdvisits = sd(n, na.rm = TRUE),
            minvisits = min(n, na.rm = TRUE),
            maxvisits = max(n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  round(digits = 2)
```

*********************************
------Medication: stats ------

Start with working out how many visits each participant had where medication data was recorded
```{r : medication entries}
medication_entries_per_patient <- meds_wide %>%
  group_by(CO.ID) %>%
  summarise(n = n())
```

```{r : medication stats}
overallvisitsstats$patientswithmed <- n_unique(meds_wide$CO.ID)

overallvisitsstats$visitswithmed <- n_unique(meds_wide$Assessment.ID)
```

```{r : prescriptions - medicines}
medication_clean$prescribedmedperpatient <- paste(medication_clean$coid_asse_id, medication_clean$Medicine)
  
medprescriptions <- subset(medication_clean, assessment_entry == 1)

all_prescriptions <- medprescriptions %>%
  group_by(Medicine) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Medicine,
              values_from = n)

othermeds <- subset(medication_clean, Medicine == "Other")
```
